propositions: rebar transition close exits with code 0 and reports lock error to stderr after close is durably committed, silently dropping the completion signature
close_ticket returns success payload with no field indicating signature outcome, making the loss undetectable programmatically to library, CLI, or MCP consumers
SigningError from signing tail is caught and downgraded without distinguishing transient lock timeout (requires retry) from permanent operator-fixable failures (missing ssh-keygen)

completion_signature dict with signed bool, cause string, and error string must be threaded through all three public surfaces (rebar.transition library, CLI --output json, MCP transition_ticket) so callers can detect loss on fixed exit code 0
idea to closed transition must not include completion_signature key since rejection of undesigned idea is not a completion
material drift refusal path must report signed false with cause material_drifted, and force close must report cause force_bypassed
